website.note: PRP described as pre-clinical preparing for human trials; no separate /pipeline page (404).

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Lead asset PRP (intravenous combination of trypsinogen + chymotrypsinogen proenzymes for advanced solid tumors; FDA Orphan Designation 2017) remains in preclinical stage. Per FY2025 10-K, the company plans to file a Clinical Trial Application (CTA) and commence a First-In-Human Phase Ib multiple-ascending-dose study in advanced solid tumor patients in H2 calendar 2026, contingent on raising sufficient capital. POP1 backup compound is at discovery stage. No Phase 1/2/3 trial currently active or registered.

excluded_preclinical.stage: Preclinical / CTA preparation; planned FIH Phase Ib H2 2026
